name: Grapefruit oil
description: Grapefruit oil (CAS 8016-20-4 ), also known by FEMA 2530 , is a cold-pressed citrus essential oil derived from the peel of Citrus paradisi. It delivers a sharp, fresh citrus character that drives demand across both flavoring and fragrance applications. Procurement buyers source it primarily for its natural origin positioning and distinctive scent-flavor profile. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a natural flavoring agent in soft drinks and confectionery. It is ideal for citrus-forward flavor blends where authentic grapefruit character is required. Personal care formulators incorporate it into perfumes, body washes, and skincare products to provide top-note citrus fragrance. The oil offers significant natural ingredient appeal for modern consumer brands. Household and industrial cleaning products use it as a functional fragrance component, where the citrus note supports a fresh, clean sensory perception. Flavor houses also blend it into compound flavors targeting beverage concentrates and functional drink formulations. Grapefruit oil is supplied as a pale yellow to yellow mobile liquid for industrial use. The product is available in food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications to meet diverse needs. Cold-pressed grades are the market standard, with quality benchmarked against FEMA 2530 compliance and natural flavor regulations. Packaging typically ranges from small drums to bulk containers depending on volume requirements.
